## Next Commands
```

aub spawn --lane 21b5700bf9943671 --mutations 3 --base-run db08d79b484756ab
aub validate --run db08d79b484756ab --oos-full --export-if-pass
```

## Rationale
1. **Status/verify**: Confirms champion file integrity given blank file field
2. **Spawn**: Generates 3 mutations from current best run to explore neighborhood
3. **Validate**: Full OOS validation on champion run; exports to production pipeline if passing
